No file in check_take.CHECKER_CODE_FILES, READER_SOURCES or CODEX_SOURCES is edited, no test is loosened, and the draft is not regenerated. Second commit (glitch-45's round on review 49c93d2 and athena gap4-prebeacon3-49c93d2): test_cp8_prep's tearDownModule put back the modules it found instead of dropping walk_register, which had left walk_plan's walk_register and sys.modules' apart for every later module of the single-process test_round4, so test_walk_counts' two register-folder tests patched a copy the road never read; walk_counts uses the store only while every road module's module references are the objects sys.modules holds (the guard reads one copy, the road the other); the ceiling rule reads each entry resolved only, and an entry that cannot be resolved (a link loop, RuntimeError before Python 3.13) stands the store down; H9 asserts the live-box step's pass line names its stand-in record. The guard compares the road's three module references by identity whatever they hold and reads this module's own names through globals(); test_walk_layout and test_holdout_digests put back the real modules at teardown as test_cp8_prep does.
